name: @aise/world-ux
description: AISE world UX package (WORLD-P4): the game-world UX transformation contracts — the restrained seven-panel in-world HUD (objective/evidence/constraints/agent/validation/cost-boq/timeline) and the spatial surface station contract as READ-ONLY typed projections COMPOSING the six landed world packages (P0-A reality substrate scene composition, P0-B understanding substrate, P0-C solution substrate scene-usage/4D, P1 Layer-1 world/evidence lane, P2 Layer-2 problem/evidence/action lane, P3 Layer-3 interactive solution lane). The HUD explains engineering state without replacing the scene; the surface carries the composed scene with ghost-distinctness, identity quarantine and resolvable ghost-removed elements; the wiring binds the route to the lane state through typed ports whose in-memory substitution doubles compose the REAL lane fixtures end-to-end (P1 fixture world + P2 lane run + P3 lane run) with zero substrate installed. LaneFailure presentation is UNIFIED to the P2/P3 family shape (kind from the CLOSED HFX-000 vocabulary carried verbatim, detail carried verbatim — the recorded P4 seam decision). Ghost-deleted element ids stay RESOLVABLE in the composed station scene; authored intents fail closed on missing_operation_provenance; the Objective panel wires LIVE clash→problem bindings from the P3 coordination family. No panel and no surface is ever an engineering authority; the BOQ Graph stays the only quantity authority; no substrate object id ever becomes canonical AISE identity. No network, no clock reads, no randomness, no I/O in the contract core.
